lead: The sunshine vitamin, all year round. 2,000 IU of vitamin D3 in an easy daily softgel — to support strong bones and teeth, a healthy immune system, muscle function and mood, especially through the darker months when sunlight runs short.

science.title: Why most of us run low
science.text: Your skin makes vitamin D from sunlight — but indoors, in winter, or in colder regions, you simply don't make enough, which is linked with low energy and the winter blues. D3 (cholecalciferol) is the same form your body produces from the sun and uses most effectively. It helps you absorb calcium for strong bones and teeth, supports your immune system, and plays a role in muscle function and mood. A small daily softgel keeps your levels topped up year-round.

format.title: One small softgel a day
format.text: No big tablets, no taste — a tiny oil-based softgel that's easy to swallow and helps the fat-soluble vitamin absorb. One bottle is over three months' supply.

absorb.title: From softgel to strong bones
absorb.lead: Vitamin D3 is converted into its active form, which helps your gut absorb calcium and signals your immune system — the reason it matters head to toe.

points.title: Calcium for bones

points.title: Immune support

points.title: Muscle & mood

items.q: Why vitamin D3 rather than D2?
items.a: D3 (cholecalciferol) is the same form your skin makes from sunlight and is more effective at raising and maintaining your blood vitamin D levels than D2.

items.q: Is 2,000 IU a good daily amount?
items.a: Yes — 2,000 IU (50 mcg) is a common, well-tolerated daily maintenance dose for adults topping up low levels, particularly in winter.
